page.title: JIT compilation
page.desc: Compiling at runtime using observed behaviour: V8, the JVM's HotSpot and PyPy start interpreting, profile hot code and compile it with speculative optimisations that deoptimise when assumptions break.
page.intro: Compiling at runtime using observed behaviour: V8, the JVM's HotSpot and PyPy start interpreting, profile hot code and compile it with speculative optimisations that deoptimise when assumptions break.

synapses.text: A JIT guesses types from what it has seen, compiles fast code for that case, and falls back if a different type appears.
V8 runs Ignition (interpreter), then Sparkplug and TurboFan; HotSpot has C1 and C2; each tier spends more compile time for faster code.
